title: Bring your Actors and compile a reusable workflow

workflowMode.title: Workflow type
workflowMode.description: Auto routes a goal-only request into a supported recipe. Creator mode selects Instagram and YouTube internally; it does not search the full Actor Store.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Plan exports an untested project. Execute runs a bounded live test and verifies source quotes before exporting a tested project.

goal.title: Desired result
goal.default: Research Apify and produce a short source-backed brief about its Actor platform.
goal.description: Describe your desired result. For example: Give me five food content ideas for an Indian audience based on engagement on recent social posts from the last 7 days. Creator mode uses Instagram + YouTube, with evidence quality gates.

actorIds.title: Optional research Actors (leave empty for automatic selection)
actorIds.description: Optional override for website research only: apify/google-search-scraper and apify/website-content-crawler. Leave empty for creator briefs. Automatic selection is limited to supported recipes, not the whole Store.

query.title: Search query
query.description: Optional explicit web search query. Leave empty for the planner to propose one.

startUrls.title: Website URLs
startUrls.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS website URLs for the website-only recipe.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages
maxPages.description: Hard cap on pages passed to the crawler and model.

maxStepSeconds.title: Timeout per child Actor
maxStepSeconds.description: Maximum execution time for each downstream Actor.

testBudgetUsd.title: Child PPE budget allocation USD
testBudgetUsd.description: Divided into PPE caps for child runs. Pay-per-usage compute, parent compute, and AI are additional; not a hard total-dollar ceiling.

planner.title: Planner
planner.description: DeepSeek proposes a typed recipe. Fixed skips model planning for an explicitly configured supported recipe.

generatedName.title: Generated Actor name
generatedName.description: Actor name embedded in the generated project.
